title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Northwest Theater on 1972-07-21
lineage: SBD> MR> CX3(?)> D> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Stellar July‑21‑1972 performance with monster jams (The Other One, Around, China Cat→I Know You Rider) but the original SBD source is muffled and slow, though the Download Series fix restores clarity.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the show’s high energy, daring Phil‑Garcia/Billy jam into The Other One and a 22‑minute “Around,” plus tight renditions of China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, Stella Blue and Playing In The Band. The original soundboard tape is described as muffled, pitched slow and missing cuts, but the official Download Series version offers much clearer audio. Overall the music outweighs the technical flaws, making it a must‑listen for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Eight detailed reviews consistently praise the musical performance (average show rating ~4.5) while noting recording problems (average recording rating ~2.5). Weighted combination yields a solid 3.8‑star overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original SBD is muffled, pitched about +2½% slow, has cuts (drums, China Cat) and missing sections; the Download Series restoration improves clarity dramatically.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon first set (~2½ hrs) that builds momentum into a strong second set; transitions are smooth and the band maintains high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s daring interplay with Phil (and Billy) on The Other One is highlighted as "cunning and daring"; his guitar tone receives praise in several reviews.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work is repeatedly praised – “Phil bombs,” leads verses, and drives the jam into The Other One with bold improvisation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s vocal intro introduces Donna on “Playin’ In The Band”; his stage banter adds character but specific instrumental comments are minimal.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keys) is noted for unique fills on “Me & My Uncle” and contributes to the overall tightness of the band.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy’s drumming in the Phil‑Garcia jam and the extended drum segments receive positive mentions, though no detailed critique is given.
